content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Ashley Roberts (E016), contractor, Analyst role.
Requested: write access to Payroll.

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Analyst doesn't own Payroll.

Notes say security training is basic, not advanced. So contractor max is read (no advanced training).

Requested write > maximum read. Grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
